styleSummary: Polished pencil-and-ink storybook illustration with bright Mediterranean color, clean linework, expressive faces, and kid-readable mythic danger.

assets.alt: Odysseus leads armed sailors from their ship toward a walled coastal city with smoke rising behind it.
assets.notes: Primary Cicones scene reference; dramatic raid composition with ship, city, fire, and battle tension.

assets.notes: Line-art companion for the primary Cicones scene.

assets.notes: Alternate Cicones composition with a strong central Odysseus figure.

assets.alt: Black-and-white line art of Odysseus between ship and city during the Cicones battle.
assets.notes: Line-art companion for alternate Cicones composition 1.

assets.alt: Odysseus and his men fight on a beach below a smoking walled city.
assets.notes: Alternate wide Cicones composition with a clear ship-to-city route.

assets.notes: Line-art companion for alternate Cicones composition 3.

Odysseus and his crew face the huge one-eyed Cyclops Polyphemus in a rocky cave.
